raw:
@a1 assumed
  relation "go cold"
  role subject "the user's coffee"
  polarity affirmed
  basis implicature

@s1 stated
  relation "publish"
  role subject "Clarke & Partners"
  role object "Soups of Transylvania"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s2 stated
  relation "publish"
  role subject "Weber & Partners"
  role object "The Salt Road"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s3 stated
  relation "fly to"
  role subject "Ms Dobre"
  role destination "Reșița"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s4 stated
  relation "publish"
  role subject "Delta Print"
  role object "The Clockmaker's Daughter"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s5 stated
  relation "publish"
  role subject "Vertex Analytics"
  role object "Notes from the Night Train"
  polarity negated
  certainty asserted

@s6 stated
  relation "be a child of"
  role subject "Diana"
  role object "Paloma"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s7 stated
  relation "be a supplier of"
  role subject "Carpathia Energy"
  role object "Greenline Transport"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s8 stated
  relation "be a supplier of"
  role subject "Blue Harbor Media"
  role object "Tisa Textiles"
  polarity negated
  certainty asserted

@q query
  mode explain
  where match
    relation "be eligible for the bonus"
    role subject "Corina"
    polarity affirmed
  end

@q2 query
  select ?d
  where match
    relation "fly to"
    role subject "Florin Pătrașcu"
    role destination ?d
    polarity affirmed
  end

@q3 query
  select ?t
  measure start
  where match
    relation "look after"
    role subject "Bogdan-Ionuț Florea"
    role object "the analytics pipeline"
    role time ?t
    polarity affirmed
  end

@q4 query
  select ?i
  where match
    relation "commute by"
    role subject "Kamau"
    role instrument ?i
    polarity affirmed
  end
